summary: Objective-C tweaks that hook through the substrate-compatible API, with a process filter and package layout.

substrate.summary: Substrate-compatible hooking API: MSHookMessageEx, MSHookFunction, MSGetImageByName, MSFindSymbol.

templates.summary: A dylib injected into SpringBoard that hooks -[SpringBoard applicationDidFinishLaunching:] and logs when it loads.

parameters.label: Product Name

parameters.name: filterBundles
parameters.label: Inject Into
parameters.help: Bundle identifiers of the processes the tweak is loaded into.

adaptations: Kept: one constructor, identity check before any hook, os_log subsystem equal to the package id, the filter scoped to SpringBoard, mobilesubstrate as the provider dependency, the compile flags (-fvisibility=hidden, -Werror=unguarded-availability-new, -ffile-prefix-map) and the dSYM-before-strip order, now apelin-build's fixed baseline.

Changed: the runtime-only TW_HOOK table is replaced by one MSHookMessageEx call through the extension's substrate support, so the template exercises the declared hook API; the filter plist becomes package.tweakFilter; build.env/version.txt become apelin-project.json; the badge example becomes a SpringBoard launch hook.
Added: the ApelinLoaded <build id> and ApelinHooked markers confirm_loaded reads.
Added: package.icon, this extension's icon on Apelin's Pages, written as the control's Icon so a package manager shows it beside the package.
Dropped: the kill-switch file, the preferences reader and the helper daemon (other templates or later work), and the Mac-side scripts.
The hook target is the one Documents/Research/ApelinHello validated on the iOS 27 vphone.

substrate.h is written for Apelin from the published signatures. The two .tbd stubs are hand-written; their install names follow the layout the bootstraps' ElleKit packages install and Theos's own rootless/roothide stubs link against (owngoal-dev/theos-lib 514d139524300afd2fe04dc69e4be361f872c39d), read for the install names only.
